research_rationale:
Original: EO 5707 of September 4, 1931, read in full in the official OFR 1974 Hoover PEO vol. II, printed p. 993 (PDF p. 222): it authorizes two changes to the Foreign Service quarters regulations of EO 5624 — (a) adds 'in the quarters used for residence purposes' to section 15, and (b) rewrites section 20 (the three inventory scopes cover (a), the (b) instruction and the new section 20 text). Ending: EO 8189 of July 5, 1939 (4 FR 2783, held govinfo FR PDF text), 'Revocation of Executive Orders: The following executive orders are hereby revoked: ... Executive Order No. 5624 dated May 15, 1931; Executive Order No. 5707 dated September 4, 1931; ...'. EO 8189 states no effective date of its own (the 'effective July 1, 1939' sentences on the same FR page belong to EOs 8190 and 8191), so it took effect on signing, July 5, 1939 (filed July 6, 1939). The actor is EO 8189; the dossier's duplicate ACT records for EOs 8190-8192 point at the same page and were not used.
